# .NET Envoy control plane

> A .NET 10 library for xDS management servers, targeting the selected v3 root-library behavior of Envoy's Go control plane. Applications own configuration, authentication and rollout policy. Semantic validation is explicit and optional.

## Getting started and contracts

- [README](README.md): Project scope, packages, example and verification overview.
- [Repository guidance](AGENTS.md): Bootstrap, contribution and verification rules.
- [Usage and migration](docs/usage.md): Hosting, configuration updates and migration.
- [Root compatibility](docs/compatibility/root-1.0.md): Implemented surface, source pins, evidence and limits.
- [Public API](docs/public-api.md): API, ownership and lifetime contracts.
- [Example](examples/Envoy.ControlPlane.Example/README.md): Run the sample management server.

## Release and validation

- [Release record](docs/releases/root-1.0.md): Package identity and publication evidence.

- [Publishing](docs/releases/PUBLISHING.md): Protected release and verification process.
- [T26 validation conformance](docs/plan/T26-VALIDATION-CONFORMANCE.md): Declared validation scope, exceptions and recorded evidence.
